context: Two friends discuss a sports controversy and a fair-play call
purpose: Teach: グラフ/気候/減る/追わ/抜い/役者/曖昧/フェア

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨日の試合の判定、見た?あれ、フェアじゃなかったよな。
lines.en: Did you see the call in yesterday's match? That wasn't fair, right?
lines.style: Casual male university student tone, slightly indignant and inviting agreement from a peer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た!審判の説明も曖昧でさ、何が反則だったのか全然分からなかった。
lines.en: I saw it! The ref's explanation was vague too, I couldn't tell what the foul even was.
lines.style: Energetic teen boy speaking quickly and emotionally, leaning into frustration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あの選手、後ろから追いかけたんじゃなくて、普通に前から抜いただけだったろ?
lines.en: That player didn't chase him from behind, he just passed him cleanly from the front, right?
lines.style: University student replaying the scene analytically, voice rising with disbelief.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そうそう、なのにイエローカード。SNSでも批判ばっかりで、擁護する声がどんどん減ってる。
lines.en: Exactly, and yet he got a yellow card. Even on social media it's all criticism, and the voices defending him keep dwindling.
lines.style: Teen speaking with the rhythm of someone scrolling and reporting trending reactions in real time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ニュースでも審判への信頼度のグラフ出してたよ。最近の判定、気候みたいに読めないって。
lines.en: The news even showed a graph of trust in referees. They said recent calls are as unpredictable as the weather.
lines.style: University student citing news media with a half-amused, half-serious analytical tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 気候って(笑)、たとえが大きすぎ。でもあの選手、試合後のインタビュー、役者並みに落ち着いてたよな。
lines.en: The weather, lol, that's a huge comparison. But that player, in the post-match interview, was as calm as a pro actor, huh.
lines.style: Teen teasing his older friend with light laughter, then shifting to genuine admiration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほんと、俺なら絶対無理。フェアプレー賞、結局あいつが持ってくんじゃないかな。
lines.en: Seriously, I couldn't do that. I bet he'll end up taking the fair play award after all.
lines.style: University student conceding admiration, sounding genuinely impressed and a bit envious.
